name: Tuu Juliet Jatt Di
description: The star of the story—Heer—is an ambitious Kudi! Poles apart, Nawab is a rich, spoiled Munda. Destiny brings them together in a love saga inked by betrayals.

videos.title: Meet Heer, a Girl with Big Dreams
videos.overview: Heer faces poverty and abuse yet dreams of Chandigarh Prime University. Her path collides with spoiled Nawab Brar and her arrival turns his carefree life upside down

videos.title: Heer and Nawab Clash at NRI Ball
videos.overview: Nawab is shamed by his father for faking his marksheet and vows to find the girl who exposed him. Heer attends the NRI Ball, where Nawab arrives and they finally meet.

videos.title: Heer and Nawab are Trapped Together
videos.overview: Nawab saves Heer from goons, but they don’t see each other. Later at the mall, Heer hides in a trial room, unaware Nawab is inside, leaving them trapped while Taai waits outside.

videos.title: Heer’s Exam, Nawab’s Arrest
videos.overview: Heer faces Taai's accusations about her late return and dress. Her reply stuns Taai. On exam day, she must choose father or test. Nawab is arrested and they clash in a police van.

videos.title: Heer Meets Nawab at Police Station
videos.overview: Heer reaches the police station to file a complaint against her father, unaware that Nawab is also locked up there. Destiny brings them face to face at last.

videos.title: Nawab Claims Love for Heer
videos.overview: Ajeet tries to kill Heer but the Panchayat stops him. Nawab rejects his father's marriage plan, claiming he loves Heer whom he's never met. He panics when Gulab asks to meet her.

videos.title: Heer and Nawab Face a Twist
videos.overview: Heer refuses to be Nawab’s fake girlfriend but they accidentally meet in college. After Dadi throws her family out, she agrees to the deal and goes to meet his mother.

videos.title: Heer Meets Nawab's Mother
videos.overview: Heer agrees to pose as Nawabs fake girlfriend and arrives at the Brar house to meet his mother Gulaab setting the stage for unexpected turns in their complicated plan ahead for all.

videos.title: Gulaab's Surprising Approval
videos.overview: Gulaab questions Heer, and their talk turns heated, prompting her to ask Heer to leave. Later, when Nawab asks, Gulaab surprises everyone by admitting she actually liked Heer.

videos.title: Dilip Confronts Nawab
videos.overview: Pammi blackmails Heer, threatening to expose her photo with Nawab to the family. After Nawab vows to marry only Heer, Dilip confronts him for faking his love for her.

videos.title: Heer Saves Nawab
videos.overview: Heer gets furious as Nawab goes to her home looking for her. Later, Nawab falls into the river while fighting the goons, but Heer bravely jumps in and rescues him.

videos.title: Ajit Threatens Heer
videos.overview: As Nawab slips into a coma, the Brars suspect he tried to end his life for Heer. Later, Ajit forces Heer to meet his chosen suitor and warns he will harm Preeti if she refuses.

videos.title: Pammi Betrays Heer
videos.overview: As Heer nears Nawab, his condition improves. Later, in a shocking betrayal, Pammi lies to the family and accuses Heer and Nawab of being in a relationship.

videos.title: Gulaab Announces Heer's Engagement
videos.overview: Despite Heer denying any relationship with Nawab, Gulaab announces her engagement to him. Later, Neelu gives Heer jewellery and money, urging her to escape from the house.

videos.title: Heer Seeks Buzzo's Help
videos.overview: Nawab battles to come out of his coma as the Brars prepare for his and Heer's engagement. Later, a distressed Heer pleads with Buzzo to help her break the engagement.

videos.title: Nawab, Heer Get Engaged
videos.overview: Heer and Nawab exchange rings while Ajit hides the truth Buzzo told him. Later, Heer rejoices for passing the entrance exam and prepares for the scholarship interview for studies.

videos.title: Gulaab's Shocking Decision
videos.overview: Nawab regains consciousness from the coma. Later, Gulaab reveals to Heer's family that Nawab lied about loving Heer, and declares that Nawab and Heer's engagement is void.

videos.title: Sandhu Family Strikes at Brar House
videos.overview: Heer and Nawab feel relieved and joyful after their engagement is cancelled. Tensions escalate at the Brar house as Sandhu's family and relatives throw an attack.

videos.title: Dilip's Decision Sparks Argument
videos.overview: Dilip assures the Sandhu family that Heer and Nawab's wedding will proceed. Later, Gulaab and Dilip have a heated argument over his decision regarding the wedding.

videos.title: Will Gulaab's Plan Succeed?
videos.overview: Nawab and Heer wait anxiously, unsure when the looming drama will finally shatter their marriage. Will Ajit fall for Gulaab's tempting bribe to break Nawab and Heer's wedding?

videos.title: Dilip's Divorce Ultimatum
videos.overview: Dilip demands that Gulaab sign the divorce papers after learning of her attempt to stop Nawab and Heer's wedding. Later, Heer and Nawab secretly plan to stop the wedding.

videos.title: Buzzo Disguises as Nawab
videos.overview: Buzzo dresses as the groom in place of Nawab as part of their plan. The Sandhu family welcomes the Brars. Later, Pammi delivers Heer's message to Buzzo, mistaking him for Nawab.

videos.title: Nawab, Heer's Dreams in the Fire
videos.overview: Dilip stops Nawab from escaping, forcing him into the wedding. Later, Nawab and Heer feel their dreams slipping away as they walk around the fire to finish the ritual.

videos.title: Heer's Dreams Shattered by Nawab
videos.overview: Tina finds Nawab a place to stay as chaos erupts between the Brar and Sandhu families after Nawab runs away. Later, Heer mourns, feeling Nawab has shattered her dreams.

videos.title: Dilip Takes Charge of Heer's Future
videos.overview: Dilip supports Heer, taking responsibility for her education and helping her pursue her dreams. Later, the Sandhu family becomes emotional during Heer's Bidaai.

videos.title: Nawab's CPU Admission
videos.overview: Richa and Jimmy move Heer from Nawab's room to a servant's room. Later, Nawab celebrates his CPU admission as the dean refuses to increase Heer's scholarship, leaving her worried.

videos.title: Heer, Nawab Cross Paths
videos.overview: Dilip helps Heer by covering her remaining college fees after the scholarship. Later, on their first day, Heer and Nawab join the same college and encounter each other.

videos.title: Heer's Shocking Realization
videos.overview: Heer is shocked to learn that Nawab doesn't know her true identity, as he has never seen her face. Later, Pammi angrily confronts Nawab after spotting him at the college.

videos.title: Gulaab's Trick to Frame Heer
videos.overview: Gulaab stirs drama by misleading Heer and framing her for the mistake in front of Dilip, forcing her to apologise. Later, Heer and Nawab clash, and he tears up her assignment.

videos.title: Nawab Traps Heer
videos.overview: Heer grows anxious on learning that her father is drunk and beating her mother. Later, Nawab and his friends lock Heer in a room and ignore her cries for help.

videos.title: Dilip, Gulaab Hunt Heer
videos.overview: Gulaab and Dilip reach the college searching for Heer as Nawab rescues her. Later, Heer feels relieved to see Neelu safe, while Gulaab mocks Heer for being caught with a boy.

videos.title: Gulaab's Plot against Heer
videos.overview: Gulaab seeks a CPU board member to oust Heer and sabotage her exam. Later, Gulaab senses Nawab in the canteen and grows suspicious of Heer's actions.

videos.title: Heer Falls into Nawab's Trap
videos.overview: Heer enters the men's washroom and gets humiliated by the boys, unaware of Nawab's plot. Meanwhile, Gulaab fears losing her reputation if her guests learn Heer's identity.

videos.title: Will Heer Forgive Nawab
videos.overview: Nawab apologises to Heer for his actions and asks her out for the fresher party. Later, he confronts the men teasing Preeti, leaving Heer stunned.

videos.title: Gulaab Insults Heer
videos.overview: Nawab reveals to Tina his plan to take revenge on Heer, while Heer seeks Dilip's permission to attend the freshers' party. Later, Gulaab spills wine on Heer's dress.

videos.title: Nawab's Trick on Heer
videos.overview: Gulaab plans to catch Heer in order to prevent Dilip from having faith in her. At the Freshers' Party, Nawab attempts to deceive Heer for the purpose of making fun of her.

videos.title: Heer Outsmarts Nawab
videos.overview: Gulaab's remarks about Heer anger Dilip, sparking a heated argument. Meanwhile, Nawab's plan against Heer backfires, leaving him mocked and taunted by all.

videos.title: Heer Loses Dilip's Trust
videos.overview: Anmol sneaks a drunk Heer home, shattering Dilip's trust in her. Later, when Gulaab humiliates Heer, she defends herself and questions her parenting of Nawab.

videos.title: Arjun and Nawab's Heated Clash
videos.overview: Nawab, Heer and Tina are involved in an argument where Arjun interferes in a fight with Nawab. Meanwhile, Dilip calls Heer's family to their home to discuss her behaviour.

videos.title: Nawab Proposes to Tina
videos.overview: After her parents' visit, Heer feels deeply sad and decides to reveal the truth to Nawab. Later, unaware of this, Nawab plans a heartfelt proposal to Tina at the college campus.

videos.title: Gulaab's Master Plan
videos.overview: Gulaab and Lovely team up to help each other with their plans. Later, Heer argues with Gulaab over Surjit's job, and the professor assigns Nawab and Heer a project.

videos.title: Heer Rescues Nawab
videos.overview: Arjun punishes Nawab with twenty rounds, while Heer waits for him in the canteen to work on their project. Later, Nawab faints, and Heer helps him regain consciousness.

videos.title: Nawab Confronts Tina
videos.overview: Heer advises Nawab to consider others' feelings before expecting anything in return. Later, Tina fumes at Heer for being with Nawab at the hostel, while Nawab defies Tina.

videos.title: Heer Takes a Stand
videos.overview: Tina's father announces the cricket team, leaving Nawab out and sparking tension at college. Later, Heer bravely stops Ajit from beating Neelu and stands up to protect her mother.

videos.title: Heer Faces New Year Chaos
videos.overview: Heer wishes Gulaab a happy new year by bringing a drunk Ajit to her house as guests look on. Later, Heer speaks to the police about the scam money sent to her mother's account.

videos.title: Nawab Plots against Arjun
videos.overview: Nawab and his friends plan to stop Arjun from attending the cricket match. Later, Heer visits Arjun in the hospital, while Nawab regrets his impulsive decision to save Heer.

videos.title: Heer's Bright Moment
videos.overview: Neelu comforts Heer as she vents about her college chaos. Later, the professor reveals Heer's essay is on the newspaper's front page, overturning her failing grade.

videos.title: Heer's Brave Choice
videos.overview: Tina decides to push Heer out of college as jealousy over Nawab takes over. Later, Heer decides to enter the dance competition to pay Priti's fees.

videos.title: Is Nawab Falling for Heer?
videos.overview: Nawab gets lost in Heer's gaze while watching her dance. Later, Arjun and Nawab stop the drunken Ajit from embarrassing Heer during her audition and take him away.

videos.title: Nawab Discovers Tina's Deceit
videos.overview: Nawab learns about Tina's plan to betray Heer with a fake cheque. Later, a police officer arrives to take Gulaab to the station for questioning about the bank statement.

videos.title: Arjun, Nawab's Fierce Clash
videos.overview: Devastated, Heer believes it was Nawab's plan to ruin her dance performance at the cultural fest. Later, Arjun and Nawab get into a heated fight, resulting in Heer's injury.

videos.title: Nawab's Silent Care for Heer
videos.overview: The Brar family arrives at the hospital to visit Heer, while Nawab secretly talks to her. Later, Heer confides in Neelu that Nawab studies in her college.

videos.title: Heer Trusts Nawab's Truth
videos.overview: Heer tests Nawab on a lie detector and learns he is telling the truth. Later, Heer promises Nawab to keep his marriage secret after the lie detector test.

videos.title: Sunny's Affair Exposed
videos.overview: Gulaab slaps Sunny after spotting him at a hotel with a girl. Later, Nawab confronts Heer, questioning her growing closeness with Arjun and the tension deepens further.

videos.title: Nawab's Breathless Ordeal
videos.overview: Sunny apologises to Gulaab, who asks her to help Anmol secretly. Meanwhile, trapped with Nawab, Heer distracts him to prevent him from losing consciousness due to suffocation.

videos.title: Dilip Supports Heer
videos.overview: Emotionally distressed, Anmol urges Heer to stay away from her matters. Later, Dilip points out Nawab's indiscipline and offers Heer the office space meant for him.

videos.title: Heer's Office Role Sparks Tension
videos.overview: Gulaab confronts Dilip over Heer's office role as Tina apologises. Before leaving for Germany, Dilip backs Heer, who urges Anmol to stand up to Sunny.

videos.title: Heer Outsmarts Gulaab
videos.overview: Heer is forced to walk to college after Richa steals her money and debit card, but she tricks Gulaab into giving her a lift. Later, Gulaab targets Pammi to take revenge on Heer.

videos.title: Gulaab Sabotages Pammi's Match
videos.overview: Gulaab stirs up drama at the Sandhus' house with theft accusations against Pammi, leading Mahinder's family to cancel the match. Meanwhile, Nawab is captivated by Heer's gaze.

videos.title: Heer Protects Gurleen from Danger
videos.overview: Buzzo urges Nawab to stay away from Heer and focus on cricket. Later, Heer senses something wrong with Gurleen at the club and stops Sumeeth from taking her.

videos.title: Nawab Holds Heer Close
videos.overview: In an attempt to stop Heer from hitting Sumeeth, Nawab hugs her. Later, Nawab fears Heer might accept Arjun's proposal and plots to prevent her from attending college.

videos.title: Arjun Confesses to Heer
videos.overview: Gulaab accuses Heer of stealing her necklace, leading the police to arrest her. Meanwhile, encouraged by Koyal, Arjun confesses his love to Heer.

videos.title: Nawab Fights for Heer's Freedom
videos.overview: Heer refuses Gulaab's demand to return home in exchange for withdrawing the case that led to her arrest. Later, Nawab and Arjun obtain CCTV footage proving her innocence.

videos.title: Heer Thanks Nawab
videos.overview: Heer expresses gratitude to Nawab for securing her release from jail. Later, Nawab spots Heer's name on the Lohri event banner and searches for her at the college.

videos.title: Heer's Truth Stuns Nawab
videos.overview: Nawab is left shocked after learning Heer's truth and angrily confronts her, leading to a heated argument. Meanwhile, Gulaab plots to defame Pammi using Barun.

videos.title: Gulaab's Shocking Blackmail
videos.overview: Gulaab blackmails Lovely with Pammi's hotel footage, demanding Heer's return to the Sandhu home. Meanwhile, Nawab tells Buzzo that he refuses to ignore Heer.

videos.title: Heer Faces Nawab's Wrath
videos.overview: Heer reveals to everyone that she is already married, which is why she rejected Arjun's proposal. Later, Nawab fumes at Heer for revealing her secret.

videos.title: Nawab Protects Heer's Secret
videos.overview: Nawab throws coffee on Heer's laptop as Tina tries to invade privacy and discover information about Heer's husband. Later, Tina tells Heer she can be anything but never Mrs. Brar.

videos.title: Nawab Confronts Tina's Obsession
videos.overview: Tina leaves home despite her friend's pleas and drives to a village, where she is greeted warmly. However, her arrival sparks conflict when she's confronted about a video call showing her with another man, leading to a heated argument.

videos.title: Heer's Strategic Scheme
videos.overview: Nawab assures Tina she is his top priority, while Gulaab urges him to return home as Heer is away. Later, Heer devises a plan to delete Pammi's footage from Gulaab's phone.

videos.title: Nawab's Deceptive Trap for Heer
videos.overview: Nawab confronts Heer after discovering his surname attached to her name in a list. Later, Nawab proposes a scholarship transfer to another college to force Heer out of his life.

videos.title: Tina's Heartfelt Confession
videos.overview: Nawab gives Heer two days to decide on her college transfer, while Heer stops Gulaab from drinking tampered wine. Later, Tina confesses her love to Nawab as Heer watches.

videos.title: Heer Gathers Evidence
videos.overview: Heer records proof of the tampered alcohol and escapes, but ends up locked in a room with Nawab. Meanwhile, Varun meets the Sandhu family for Pammi's alliance.

videos.title: Gulaab Faces Dilip's Wrath
videos.overview: The hotel manager cancels Hansika's liquor contract and revokes her membership. Following this, Dilip fiercely criticises Gulaab for her humiliating behaviour towards Heer.

videos.title: Heer Blames Herself for the Rift
videos.overview: Heer blames herself for the conflict between Gulaab and Dilip after a heated confrontation between them. Later, a drunk Nawab imagines Heer and accuses her of distracting him.

videos.title: Heer Confronts Nawab
videos.overview: The Dean reveals that Heer leaked the question paper and suspends her from college. Later, Heer confronts Nawab for framing her to get her expelled from college.

videos.title: Dilip Trusts Heer
videos.overview: Arjun reminds Koyal of Heer's support. Later, Dilip assures Heer he believes she didn't leak the question paper, while Nawab vows to find who framed Heer, suspecting Tina.

videos.title: Nawab's Quest to Save Heer
videos.overview: Nawab prays for Heer, wishing her dreams remain intact and she escapes college expulsion. Later, Nawab vows to discover who set her up in the question paper leak.

videos.title: Heer Proves Her Innocence
videos.overview: Tina explains she accidentally put the paper in Heer's book. Later, the dean finds Heer innocent, lifts her suspension, and encourages her to attend the exams from the next day.

videos.title: Neelu's Advice to Heer
videos.overview: Neelu advises Heer to apologise to Nawab and give their relationship a chance. Later, Heer leaves her diary and an apology note at Nawab's place, and Tina ends up reading it.

videos.title: Nawab Pushes Heer Away
videos.overview: Tina reveals the pendrive has videos of Heer's marriage and questions Buzzo's presence. Later, Nawab tells Heer to stay away, making it clear his opinion of her will not change.

videos.title: Heer Faces Nawab's Rejection
videos.overview: Heer's chance meeting with Nawab rekindles warmth, but Tina's jealousy twists the moment. Nawab lashes out, forcing Heer to relive their bond as she's pushed away.

videos.title: Nawab Faces the Ultimate Threat
videos.overview: Tina's father threatens Nawab that he will end his cricket career if Tina is hurt. Later, seeing the band on Nawab's wrist, Heer assumes he has forgiven her and thanks him.

videos.title: Heer Masks Her Heartbreak
videos.overview: Heer hides her heartbreak by pretending she no longer cares about Nawab. Later, a heated public clash exposes their unresolved emotions and leaves both shaken.

videos.title: Anmol Opens Up to Heer
videos.overview: Tina plots to make Nawab believe that Heer is an obstacle in his life and career. Later, Anmol breaks down and confides in Heer about Sunny's body-shaming taunts.

videos.title: Gulaab's Bold Decision
videos.overview: Gulaab meets Vivek for her divorce, who urges her to gather details of Dilip's properties for alimony. Later, Nawab proves his fitness and gets a chance to open for the team.

videos.title: Tina's Emotional Lockdown
videos.overview: Tina locks herself in a room after seeing Nawab and Heer together in the car. Later, Heer confronts Nawab for risking her career, despite knowing Tina had leaked the papers.

videos.title: Is Dilip's Life in Danger?
videos.overview: Gulaab rejoices on learning that Nawab has filed for an annulment from Heer. But the happiness turns tragic when Dilip collapses after discovering Gulaab wants a divorce.

videos.title: Dilip's Critical State Breaks Nawab
videos.overview: Nawab's world crumbles upon seeing Dilip's condition, and Heer consoles him. Later, broken by Gulaab's accusations, Heer begins to question herself about Dilip's health.

videos.title: Nawab, Heer's Intense Gaze
videos.overview: Overwhelmed with emotion, Nawab hugs Heer, and they lose themselves in each other's gaze, reflecting on their feelings. Later, Gulaab seeks Dilip's forgiveness.

videos.title: Nawab's Hidden Feelings for Heer
videos.overview: Gulaab questions Nawab about his annulment from Heer, while he struggles with his true feelings for her. Later, Heer decides to observe a fast for Nawab on Maha Shivratri.

videos.title: Heer's Bitter Crown
videos.overview: At the Valentine's event, Heer is crushed after hearing Nawab mock her. Later, the same night, she spots them winning the King and Queen title.

videos.title: Heer Lies to Protect Tina
videos.overview: Tina tries to end her life over Nawab and Heer's closeness. Later, Gulaab and Nawab overhear Heer telling Tina she is dating Arjun, unaware she lied to save Tina.

videos.title: Nawab, Heer Part Ways
videos.overview: Gulaab grows emotional upon learning that Nawab is nearby, attending the Maha Shivratri Puja. Meanwhile, feeling sad, Heer signs the annulment papers, parting ways with Nawab.

videos.title: Nawab Races Against Time
videos.overview: Nawab reminds Heer of his two-day deadline as Tina pressures him with an engagement threat. Later, he speeds off on a bike to stop crucial evidence from reaching Gulaab.

videos.title: Heer's Forest Misadventure
videos.overview: As everyone gathers around the campfire, Heer and Nawab recall their past moments, leaving them heartbroken. Panic spreads when Heer gets lost in the dark forest.

videos.title: Heer and Nawab's Heartfelt Regret
videos.overview: Lost in the forest, Heer and Nawab take shelter at a hotel and share a room. Later, they feel heartbroken as they reflect on their impending annulment.

videos.title: Heer Faces the Verdict
videos.overview: The Judge nullifies Heer and Nawab's marriage after their confession, leaving Heer shaken. Later, the verdict is reversed after the officer's testimony, restoring Heer's hope.

videos.title: Nawab Reconsiders His Marriage
videos.overview: Heer and Nawab rejoice as their annulment is cancelled. Later, Nawab decides to give his marriage another chance, but chaos ensues when Gulaab and Heer meet with an accident.

videos.title: Gulaab Shows a New Side for Heer
videos.overview: Heer motivates a broken Nawab to work hard and chase his dreams with determination. Later, the Brar family is stunned by Gulaab's changed behaviour towards Heer.

videos.title: Heer Steps in to Stop Nawab
videos.overview: Nawab and Tina hide as Gulaab arrives at the university and announces a fundraising event. Later, Heer goes to Arjun's house and stops Nawab from clashing with Arjun.

videos.title: Neelu Strikes Heer
videos.overview: Neelu slaps Heer for lying to Nawab about Arjun being her boyfriend. Later, Nawab warns Heer to stay away from Arjun and demands she break up with him.

videos.title: Gulaab's Twisted Plan
videos.overview: Nawab's jealousy flares as he spots Heer with Arjun. Seizing the moment, Gulaab plots to turn the Sandhus against Heer by ensuring they catch her with Arjun at college.

videos.title: Heer Alerts Gurleen
videos.overview: Seeing Nawab's concern, Heer reflects on their relationship. Later, believing Gulaab's words, a worried Heer cautions Gurleen about Singhal's impending trap.

videos.title: Gulaab's Dark Alliance
videos.overview: Koyal informs Nawab that Heer and Arjun are heading to Delhi for a fundraising event. Later, Gulaab joins hands with Singhal to trap Heer in a shocking fraud case.

videos.title: Nawab Shields Heer
videos.overview: Nawab protects Heer from Singhal's goons, fighting them off. Later, Gurleen refuses to believe Heer's warnings about Singhal, unaware of Gulaab's plot.

videos.title: Heer, Arjun's Shocking Arrest
videos.overview: Nawab stops Heer from going with Arjun, leading to a heated clash. Tensions rise as the police arrest Heer and Arjun for allegedly stealing money, despite their pleas of innocence.

videos.title: Nawab's Daring Move for Heer
videos.overview: Gurleen angrily accuses Heer of being responsible for Arjun's arrest. Later, concerned for Heer, Nawab deliberately gets himself arrested to safeguard her in jail.

videos.title: The Families Turn Against Heer
videos.overview: Believing the accusations, the Brar and Sandhu families refuse to let Heer in and throw her out. Later, Heer feels relieved when Nawab expresses his faith in her.

videos.title: Nawab's Bold Stand for Heer
videos.overview: Nawab gets lost in Heer's gaze and imagines a romantic Holi with her. Tension rises when goons capture Heer, leading Nawab to fight them and boldly declare Heer as his wife.

videos.title: Tina Learns the Truth
videos.overview: Tina feels sad learning that Heer is Nawab's wife, while Heer contacts her attacker. Later, Heer tells Nawab she pretended to be Arjun's girlfriend to save Tina.

videos.title: Nawab Faces Tina's Rage
videos.overview: Tina confronts Nawab for betraying her, saying her revenge will be satisfied when Heer leaves him. Later, Gulaab escapes before Heer spots her and learns she was behind the attack.

videos.title: Heer, Nawab's Plot Against Singhal
videos.overview: When college students accuse Heer, Nawab firmly defends her. Later, he and Heer plan to lure Singhal into a trap to uncover the truth.

videos.title: Nawab Suspects Gulaab
videos.overview: Heer and Nawab cunningly trap Singhal and secretly recording his crime. Later, a determined Nawab vows to uncover why Gulaab is involved with Singhal.

videos.title: Singhal Admits His Crimes
videos.overview: Singhal confesses his schemes and crimes against Heer, clearing the charges against her. Meanwhile, Nawab takes up a waiter's job at Heer's insistence.

videos.title: Dilip Apologises to Heer
videos.overview: The Brars visit the Sandhus to take Heer home, and Dilip seeks forgiveness for not trusting her. Later, Heer boosts Nawab's confidence, leading to a sweet moment between them.

videos.title: Gulaab Hits Heer
videos.overview: Gulaab is stunned and has a panic attack seeing Nawab and Heer together. In anger, she slaps Heer for making Nawab work as a waiter, prompting him to take a stand.

videos.title: Nawab, Heer's First Date
videos.overview: Accusing Heer of betrayal, Gulaab vows to remove her from Nawab's life. Romance blossoms as Nawab gets lost in Heer's beauty and the two head out for their first date.

videos.title: Gulaab Challenges Heer
videos.overview: Heer stops Nawab from using the credit card given by Gulaab. Nawab overhears and feels furious as Gulaab challenges Heer, claiming that he will soon side with her.

videos.title: Tina Tests Nawab's Tolerance
videos.overview: Gulaab seeks Tina's help to bring Nawab back to her, assuring that she will get her married to him. Soon, Heer cheers Nawab and calms his anger after Tina tests his patience.

videos.title: Nawab Cuts Ties With Tina
videos.overview: Nawab ends his relationship with Tina and refuses to meet her again. Gulaab takes every measure to ensure Nawab is not selected for the cricket team.

videos.title: Nawab and Karan's Cricket Clash
videos.overview: Nawab grows furious upon seeing Dilip give his cricket kit to Arjun. Heer then pushes him to challenge Karan in a cricket match, with the winner securing a place in the team.

videos.title: Can Nawab Claim the Win?
videos.overview: Nawab asks Gulaab whether she will accept Heer if he wins the cricket challenge against Karan. Dilip joins Heer and cheers for Nawab. Will Nawab manage to secure the victory?

videos.title: Heer Doubts Nawab
videos.overview: Nawab feels grateful to Heer for trusting him despite accusations of hitting Karan. Shortly after, Heer suspects him of sneaking into Gurleen's room and frightening her.

videos.title: Gulaab's Vow to Break Heer, Nawab
videos.overview: Gulaab watches Nawab lovingly teach Heer cricket and vows to make him remove Heer from his life. Then, Heer feels happy as Nawab gifts her a ring, promising to change himself.

videos.title: Will Nawab Take Tina's Offer?
videos.overview: Heer urges Nawab to control his aggression and play the match to prove his talent. Soon, Tina offers him a deal to divorce Heer, assuring him a place in the state cricket team.

videos.title: Nawab Loses Heer's Trust
videos.overview: Nawab destroys key documents and admits entering the locker room, shocking everyone. Gulaab confesses framing him, but Heer loses trust and cuts all ties, leaving Nawab shattered.

videos.title: Arjun Learns Nawab, Heer's Truth
videos.overview: Arjun is stunned to learn that Heer is Nawab's wife. Gulaab insists that Nawab break his relationship with Heer, so he decides to divorce Heer.

videos.title: Nawab on a Vengeful Path
videos.overview: Nawab lashes out after a bitter confrontation with Heer and destroys their shared memories. Heer stands fearless, while Nawab vows revenge and a dark return.

videos.title: Heer Walks Away From Nawab
videos.overview: Heer takes Neelu and Preeti to Mannu's house temporarily, breaking her relationship with Nawab. At the cafe, Nawab creates a scene and misbehaves with the customers.

videos.title: Gulaab Disregards Ajit's Threat
videos.overview: Ajit warns Gulaab that he will expose her schemes to Heer, but she remains unfazed. Buzzo urges Heer to control a drunken Nawab, yet Heer lets him drink, suppressing her emotions.

videos.title: Nawab Sabotages Heer's Interview
videos.overview: Heer tries to impress the interviewer to crack a job, but Nawab insults her and tells the interviewer not to hire her. Sunny tries to trick Dilip into signing property papers.

videos.title: Nawab's Dangerous Jealousy
videos.overview: Heer strives for a university job, but Nawab demoralises her. Arjun comes to her support, and out of jealousy, Nawab hurts himself while Gulaab blames Heer for his condition.

videos.title: Heer Respects Gulaab's Decision
videos.overview: Heer believes Gulaab's choice to live independently is a just consequence. Nawab confides in Buzzo, heartbroken that Heer abandoned him when he needed her most.

videos.title: Heer Caught in Nawab's Demands
videos.overview: Surjit urges Heer to bring Nawab to meet Pammi's wedding alliance. Soon after, Nawab demands that Heer publicly praise him over the college announcement system in return.

videos.title: Nawab and Heer's Blissful Times
videos.overview: Heer greets Diljeet's family, who bring his alliance for Pammi. Meanwhile, Nawab and Heer share playful banter, mocking the challenge of tolerating each other.

videos.title: Nawab Cares for Heer
videos.overview: Heer suspects that Daljeet is with another girl and urges everyone to play the Jodi No. 1 game to expose him. Nawab shows concern when Heer hurts her hand with a candle.

videos.title: Nawab, Heer Face New Clash
videos.overview: Nawab's dance with Heer turns dramatic as he saves her, but her plan fails miserably. Then, Pammi asks Heer to leave, while Gulaab demands that the divorce papers be signed.

videos.title: Nawab Misreads Heer Again
videos.overview: Gulaab leaves Nawab with Heer despite tensions and misunderstandings. As Heer tries to make amends, Daljeet poisons her food, leaving her ill.

videos.title: Nawab Fights to Save Heer
videos.overview: Heer fakes pregnancy and follows Daljeet with Nawab, but their plan fails. Alone, she is kidnapped, and Nawab rushes to rescue her.

videos.title: Gulaab Strikes a Deal
videos.overview: Surjit urges Heer to leave the house to save Pammi's marriage. Gulaab offers Heer proof against Daljeet in exchange for signing divorce papers to protect Pammi's life.

videos.title: Nawab Stands Up for Neelu
videos.overview: Heer and Nawab plan to expose Daljeet before he marries Pammi. Nawab and Buzzo sneak Heer in a trunk, while Nawab defends Neelu and Preeti from Ajit's aggression.

videos.title: Nawab Saves Heer Amid Chaos
videos.overview: Nawab helps Heer expose Daljeet, but their plan backfires when he learns it. Heer worries as Daljeet collapses, then Nawab calms her down.

videos.title: Daljeet's Secret Gets Exposed
videos.overview: Sophia reveals to Pammi and everyone that she is in a relationship with Daljeet. Nawab defends Heer from Daljeet, while Pammi uncovers Gulaab's plan to get Daljeet married to her.

videos.title: Heer's Gratitude to Nawab
videos.overview: Neelu confides in Gulaab that even God cannot break Heer and Nawab's bond. Heer thanks Nawab for saving Pammi and decides to sort things out with Gulaab.

videos.title: Heer Dreams of Nawab
videos.overview: Daljeet accuses Heer of trapping Pammi for marriage. Heer envisions Nawab surprising her on her birthday, asking Anmol to save some cake in the hope that he'll come to wish her.

videos.title: Nawab's Guilty Conscience
videos.overview: Nawab grows anxious and regrets the night he spent with Tina. Buzzo urges him to hide the truth from Heer and find a way to manage the situation with Tina.

videos.title: Heer Faces Pain of Betrayal
videos.overview: Arjun reveals Nawab's disloyalty to Heer, leaving her heartbroken. Emotions run high as Nawab apologises and seeks forgiveness, while Gulaab intensifies her pain.

videos.title: Nawab Gets Jealous
videos.overview: Heer's and Arjun's sizzling cover shoot sparks jealousy, sending Nawab into a spiral. Amid rising tensions and hidden insecurities, Heer finds herself under intense scrutiny.

videos.title: Heer, Nawab's Chemistry Shines
videos.overview: Nawab disguises himself and locks Arjun in his house to prevent him from doing the photoshoot. Soon, Heer and Nawab's intense chemistry amazes all as their magazine shoot begins.

videos.title: Buzzo Executes Nawab's Plan
videos.overview: Nawab rescues Heer from a falling chandelier, and they strike the perfect pose for the magazine cover. Buzzo gets Tina drunk as part of Nawab's plan to make her confess the truth.

videos.title: Arjun Shocks Heer
videos.overview: Heer supports Tina and protects her secret, even stopping a violent clash. But Arjun's shocking revelation shatters Heer's belief and changes everything.

videos.title: Gulaab's Unexpected Setback
videos.overview: Arjun tells Heer that Tina revealed the truth to ruin her bond with Nawab. Gulaab's plan backfires when Ajit uses Heer's birth certificate to blackmail Dilip for his properties.

videos.title: Ajit's Deal With Heer
videos.overview: Heer confronts Ajit for falsely accusing Nawab of an underage marriage to her. Ajit offers to drop the case if Heer agrees to quit her studies midway.

videos.title: Heer Seizes Nawab's Arrest
videos.overview: Drama spirals as police come to arrest Nawab and Heer, but she locks him into a safe place. Heer makes an emotional sacrifice, ending her marriage to Nawab to save his life.

videos.title: Nawab Plans to Remarry Heer
videos.overview: Nawab conducts a lie detector test on Heer to uncover the truth. Soon, Ajit plots to ruin Nawab's career as Nawab prepares to propose to Heer again.

videos.title: Heer Rejects Nawab's Proposal
videos.overview: With Neelu's help, Heer sets out to expose Ajit's lie about her age. Nawab's romantic proposal with a ring ends in rejection as she says no under compulsion.

videos.title: Gulaab Celebrates Heer's Downfall
videos.overview: To save Nawab's career, and under Ajit's orders, Heer rejects his proposal, claiming no love. Gulaab openly rejoices as Heer leaves the house.

videos.title: Heer Gets Engaged to Arjun!
videos.overview: A month later, Heer and Nawab begin living separate lives but struggle to move on from each other. Soon, Buzzo and Koyal are stunned to learn that Heer is engaged to Arjun.

videos.title: Heer's True Feelings
videos.overview: Nawab thanks Arjun for his captaincy, which helped him get selected for Ranji Trophy. Heer confesses to Arjun that she still loves Nawab and can't reveal their engagement truth.

videos.title: Arjun's Words for Nawab
videos.overview: Arjun says Nawab is everyone's choice, but he's the only option, echoing Heer's words. Dilip urges Heer not to tell Nawab the truth, fearing it could ruin his career.

videos.title: Shivam Faces Nawab's Fury
videos.overview: Shivam misbehaves with Heer and faces Nawab's fury. Nawab's hard-fought Ranji Trophy selection fills Dilip with pride and calls for celebration.

videos.title: Arjun's Brave Move
videos.overview: Anmol feels sad as Sunny ignores her. At the party, Sunny meets Pammi and gifts her a bracelet, while Arjun helps strike down Shivam as he points a gun at Heer and Nawab.

videos.title: Heer Faces New Rival
videos.overview: Nawab's emotions stir after learning that Heer and Arjun are engaged. The principal informs Heer about a competitor as she decides to work as a lecturer.

videos.title: Heer's Search for Nawab
videos.overview: Nawab takes advice from a mysterious woman to cope with his heartbreak over Heer. Worried about Nawab, Heer sets out to find him, putting her job interview at risk.

videos.title: Tina's Advice to Arjun
videos.overview: Nawab confronts Heer for caring for him and asks her to move on, pushing her to impress the principal for a job. Tina reminds Arjun that Nawab and Heer are meant for each other.

videos.title: Heer's Kindness Backfires Badly
videos.overview: Heer prepares for her interview while Nawab takes Anmol's office role, shocking Sunny and Gulaab. After helping Nawab out of the mud, Heer is left furious as her dress is ruined.

videos.overview: Daadi lets Heer and Simran stay while Simran secretly dreams of Nawab. Heer is shocked to see Gulaab, the budgetary committee head, as she offers her scholarship.
